ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white mottling concentrated on the outer distal thirds of both lobes. Centrally, a large contiguous region of low-intensity black pigmentation extends from the lower peduncle insertion point to the median notch. Small, low-intensity circular spots are scattered within the white distal fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 15 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jaggedness; trailing edge consists of approximately 12-14 primary peaks per lobe with deep inter-peak valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave upward curvature on both lobes, tapering to sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) located along the perimeter of the distal tips and the extreme outer margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple light-grey vertical and diagonal linear streaks visible on the dark pigmented central regions of both lobes, particularly a series of four parallel rake marks on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization along the leading and trailing edges of the distal tips; multiple white-on-black linear scarring patterns across the medial ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge profile with significant pixel-level variation compared to standard smooth-edge profiles.
